title: Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI
abstract: arXiv:2610.28411v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning models have become essential tools in medical imaging, yet training them end-to-end for diverse tasks remains challenging due to limited labeled data and computational constraints. To address this, we introduce Brain2Vec, a foundation model pre-trained on 74,425 T1-weighted Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans pooled from multiple studies. Brain2Vec can serve both as a weight initialization backbone for fine-tuning downstream tasks and as a standalone feature extractor. We evaluated Brain2Vec in three tasks: downstream predictive performance, convergence speed, and embedding quality. Using Brain2Vec's pretrained weights as initialization and fine-tuning on labeled data for a brain age prediction task, results demonstrate improved final accuracy and faster convergence compared to random initialization. Additionally, its frozen embeddings outperform anatomically defined volumetric features on four of five downstream class

translated_title: Brain2Vec：一种用于结构化脑部MRI的自监督3D基础模型
translated_abstract: 深度学习模型已成为医学影像领域不可或缺的工具，然而由于标注数据有限和计算资源受限，针对多样化任务进行端到端训练仍然充满挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Brain2Vec，这是一个在汇集自多项研究的74,425个T1加权磁共振成像（MRI）扫描数据上预训练的基础模型。Brain2Vec既可以作为权重初始化的骨干网络用于下游任务的微调，也可以作为独立的特征提取器使用。我们从三个方面对Brain2Vec进行了评估：下游预测性能、收敛速度和嵌入质量。在脑年龄预测任务中，使用Brain2Vec的预训练权重作为初始化并在标注数据上进行微调，结果表明与随机初始化相比，最终精度得到提升且收敛速度更快。此外，其冻结嵌入特征在五个下游分类任务中的四个上优于基于解剖学定义的体积特征。
tldr: Brain2Vec是一个在74,425个T1加权脑部MRI扫描上预训练的自监督3D基础模型，既可作为下游任务微调的权重初始化骨干，也可作为独立特征提取器，在脑年龄预测等任务中展现出更高的精度和更快的收敛速度。
en_tdlr: Brain2Vec is a self-supervised 3D foundation model pre-trained on 74,425 T1-weighted structural brain MRI scans, serving as both a weight initialization backbone for fine-tuning downstream tasks and a standalone feature extractor, demonstrating improved accuracy and faster convergence on tasks such as brain age prediction.
